title: Understanding the Problem
text: To find the launch angle, we need to consider the horizontal and vertical components of the motion. The horizontal distance covered is $$69.0\, \text{m}$$, $$and$$ $$the$$ $$initial$$ $$speed$$ $$is$$ $$35.8\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$.

title: Breaking Down the Motion
text: The horizontal component of the velocity can be expressed as $$v_x=v cos\left(\theta\right)$$, $$where$$ $$v$$ is the initial speed and $$\theta$$ is the launch angle.

title: Time of Flight
text: The time of flight can be calculated using the horizontal motion equation: $$d=v_x t$$, $$where$$ $$d$$ is the horizontal distance.

title: Vertical Motion Equation
text: The vertical component of the velocity is $$v_y=v sin\left(\theta\right)$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$the$$ $$vertical$$ $$motion$$ $$equation$$ $$y=v_y*t-0.5*g*t**{2}$$ to find the time of flight.

title: Calculate the Launch Angle
text: Using the equations for horizontal and vertical motion, solve for the launch angle $$\theta$$.
